ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to Technical Systems Management or Crop Sciences or Agr and Consumer Economics or Food and Agribusiness Management major(s) or minor(s). FAM minors need to contact Dung Quach-Wisdom at pdq@illinois.edu for access. Restricted to sophomore, junior, and senior class standing. The section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from our department with specific attendance directives.
